description.value: The Dirty Apron is a cooking school, award-winning delicatessen, and full-service catering company in downtown Vancouver's Crosstown neighbourhood, founded in 2009 by Chef David Robertson and Sara Robertson. It teaches over 10,000 students a year and produces gourmet deli fare alongside curated picnics and catering. A touring cyclist stopping downtown will find freshly made lunches and baked goods at the deli counter.

address.value: 540 Beatty Street, Crosstown Vancouver, BC V6B 2L3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Dirty Apron is located at 540 Beatty Street, Vancouver BC V6B 2L3 — not in Richmond — directly contradicting the OSM coordinates (lat 49.192, lon -123.180) which place this record near Sea Island/YVR. The discovery notes acknowledge a hypothetical 'YVR airport location' but the website shows no such location exists. GF and vegetarian options are confirmed from the daily specials text; deli pickup is confirmed via the FAQ. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, wi-fi, or other cyclist amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Critical location mismatch: OSM coordinates (49.1925, -123.1809) place this record on Sea Island, Richmond near YVR, but the website lists only one location — 540 Beatty Street, Vancouver BC V6B 2L3. URL discovery notes reference a 'YVR airport location' but no such location is confirmed on the website.
OSM has no address field populated, making coordinate-vs-address cross-check impossible from OSM data alone.
If the Richmond/YVR node is erroneous, this record should be re-geocoded to 540 Beatty St, Vancouver, or removed as a duplicate/phantom.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM node is plotted in Richmond near YVR (Sea Island), but the business website exclusively shows a Vancouver address at 540 Beatty Street. No YVR or Richmond location is mentioned anywhere on the website, so it is unclear whether this OSM node represents a real second location or a misplaced record for the Vancouver shop.
enrichment_extras.notes: If a YVR airport outpost does exist (e.g. an airside or landside kiosk not yet reflected on the website), on-the-ground verification is needed before inclusion. The main Vancouver location at 540 Beatty St is clearly real and active.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Daily specials list multiple items labelled GF/Vegetarian, including Roasted Squash & Apple Soup (GF/Vegetarian) and BBQ Broccolini & Radicchio Salad (GF/Vegetarian)
